gloss: strange tale; variant account; unusual story

definitions.gloss: strange tale; unusual story; curious report
definitions.explanation: A story about something strange or extraordinary, especially supernatural or mysterious events.
A different version or differing account of a known story or historical event.

examples.japanese: {各地|かくち}の{異聞|いぶん}を{集|あつ}めた。
examples.english: I collected strange tales from various regions.

examples.japanese: この{村|むら}には{古|ふる}くから{伝|つた}わる{異聞|いぶん}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: This village has many strange tales passed down from old times.

examples.japanese: {妖怪|ようかい}{異聞|いぶん}をテーマにした{小説|しょうせつ}を{読|よ}んだ。
examples.english: I read a novel themed around tales of yōkai.

examples.japanese: この{歴史|れきし}には{異聞|いぶん}がある。
examples.english: There is a variant account of this history.

examples.japanese: {正史|せいし}とは{異|こと}なる{異聞|いぶん}が{残|のこ}されている。
examples.english: An alternative account differing from the official history has been preserved.

examples.japanese: {本能寺|ほんのうじ}の{変|へん}にまつわる{異聞|いぶん}は{数多|かずおお}く{存在|そんざい}する。
examples.english: Numerous variant accounts exist regarding the Incident at Honnōji.

notes:
FORMATION:
{異|い} (different, strange) + {聞|ぶん} (hearing, report).

USAGE:
A literary word often found in book titles, folklore collections, and historical writing. Sense 1 emphasizes the strangeness of the story, while sense 2 emphasizes that the account differs from the standard version. Frequently appears in titles of games, manga, and novels (e.g., 〇〇{異聞|いぶん}).

RELATED:
- {怪談|かいだん} (ghost story, horror tale)
- {奇談|きだん} (strange or curious tale)
- {伝説|でんせつ} (legend)
